description: Three documented observations with source rights: precipitation, water phases, and bird/crocodilian coexistence.

images.title: Precipitation beneath a storm cloud
images.summary: A NOAA National Severe Storms Laboratory photograph shows a shelf cloud and a descending rain shaft above open grassland.
images.alt: Dark storm clouds over a flat grassy landscape, with a pale curtain of falling rain on the right.
images.caption: Water evaporates into the atmosphere, condenses into clouds and returns to the surface as precipitation. This photograph records the cloud and precipitation stages; evaporation and invisible water vapor are not directly visible.
images.credit: NOAA National Severe Storms Laboratory / NOAA Photo Library
images.rights: US federal NOAA work, marked public domain in the US; source Flickr license also CC BY 2.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Credit NOAA.
images.processing: Observed source re-encoded by the archive importer as a maximum 1800-pixel JPEG, quality 87, with orientation corrected if needed; original source retained by URL. No synthetic content or compositional alterations introduced.

images.title: Ice, liquid water and fog in Iceland
images.summary: A photograph of an iceberg in Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon during foggy weather in southeastern Iceland.
images.alt: A large pale, jagged iceberg surrounded by liquid water and fog in a grayscale photograph.
images.caption: Solid ice floats in liquid water. The fog consists of suspended liquid droplets; gaseous water vapor itself is invisible. This photograph illustrates natural phase changes, not direct observation of the gaseous phase.
images.rights: CC BY-SA 2.0, Tim Sackton; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Re-encoded derivative remains under the same license.
images.processing: Observed source re-encoded by the archive importer as a maximum 1800-pixel JPEG, quality 87, with orientation corrected if needed; original source retained by URL. No synthetic content or compositional alterations introduced. Source monochrome rendering retained.

images.title: Egyptian geese and a crocodile in Botswana
images.summary: A documented wildlife photograph of Egyptian geese (Alopochen aegyptiaca) and a crocodile at Chobe National Park, Botswana.
images.alt: Egyptian geese near a crocodile in a natural habitat.
images.caption: Birds and crocodilians share an evolutionary ancestry within the archosaurs. Both groups still live on Earth. This photograph records representatives of both groups in one habitat; the source does not identify the crocodile to species.
